result.summary: Found 1 clear defect: an invalid delivery fee value rendered as €NaN on a restaurant card. Other clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff are excluded per instructions.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in 'Fastest near you' displays '€NaN delivery', indicating the delivery price failed to resolve to a valid number.
issues.suggestion: Guard the delivery-fee formatting against null/undefined/NaN and either compute the fee correctly, show a fallback such as 'Delivery unavailable', or hide the card until pricing data loads.
